title: Careers in pharmaceutical water engineering | Aquemi
meta: Join a Canadian team that designs, welds, tests and qualifies pharmaceutical water systems. Open roles in engineering, fabrication, validation and service.
headline: Build systems that pass inspection
lead: We hire engineers, welders, technicians and validation specialists who like exact work. You see a system through from drawing to qualified handover.

body: Our projects are small enough that one engineer can know the whole system and regulated enough that every detail is recorded. You will read a URS, draw a P&ID, watch your design get welded and tested, and see it pass FAT with the client in the room.
We train people in pharmaceutical water practice. Many of our team members came from [food, dairy, power or general process work] and learned GMP documentation here.

blocks.intro: Current openings are listed below. If none fits, send a general application.

items.d: Sizing and design of PW, WFI and Pure Steam systems; P&IDs and specifications.
PLC and HMI programming, GAMP 5 software specifications, controls OQ.
Sanitary 316L tube welding to ASME BPE, weld logs and borescope inspection.
FAT, SAT and IQ/OQ protocol writing and execution.
Commissioning, preventive maintenance and calibration at client sites in [region].
Schedule, cost and client communication from order to handover.
